## Treatment Periods (Daily Allowances)

#### Procedure Description:

Registering the contributor's treatment periods (in-patent treatment, on sick leave, treatment while in employment) as determined by the treating body.

#### Procedure Conditions:

Determining treatment periods by the treating physician

### Extending Treatment Periods

#### Procedure Description:

Extending the treatment periods of an injured contributor in accordance with his medical case based on the decision of the treating physician and the approval of the Medical Department in GOSI office.

#### Procedure Conditions:

1\. Treating physician requests the extension of treatment period.\
2. GOSI physician approves the extension of treatment period.\

[Occupational Injuries](#collapse3)

### Report an injury

## Report an injury

#### Procedure Description:

The employer should notify the approved treatment body or the concerned GOSI office about the injury that was sustained by any of his workers whom is covered under the social insurance scheme.

#### Procedure Conditions:

1. The injured contributor worker should be registered under the social insurance scheme prior to the date on injury.\
2. The injury should be reported within three days after the worker notifies his employer about the injury or after the employer takes note of its occurrence

#### Service delivery channels

[](#DetailData)

At

Office

### Injury Case Closure

#### Procedure Description:

Closing the injured contributor's file at the treatment body after the end of his treatment.

#### Procedure Conditions:

1\. End of treatment and condition becomes stabilized.\
2. The file of the injured contributor is closed by the treating physician.

#### Service delivery channels

[](#DetailData)

At

Office

### Deterioration or Complication

#### **Procedure Description:**

The employer notifies GOSI competent office or the approved treatment body about the deterioration or complication that occurs to the injured contributor as a result of a previous work injury which already had been approved.

#### **Procedure Conditions:**

• Deterioration or complication occurs as a result of a previous work injury which already had been approved.

**Note**: In this case, it is not required for the injured contributor to be in employment at the time when the deterioration or complication occurs. 

#### Service delivery channels

[](#DetailData)

Through

GOSI Online

[Payments for Occupational Disability cases](#collapse4)

### Payment of total permanent occupational disability wage.

## Payment of total permanent occupational disability wage.

#### Procedure Description:

It is a monthly wage paid to an injured contributor for a  disability rate of 100%.

**Note:** Determining the disability percentage is decided by competent GOSI medical boards.

#### Procedure Conditions:

1\. The contributor is a Saudi national. \
2. The employment injury resulted in a total permanent disability to the contributor by (100%). \
 

#### Service delivery channels

[](#DetailData)

At

Office

### Payment of partial permanent occupational disability wage.

## Payment of partial permanent occupational disability wage.

#### Procedure Description:

It is a monthly benefit paid to an injured contributor for a disability rate of 50% to less than 100%.

**Note:** Determining the disability percentage is decided by competent GOSI medical boards.

#### Procedure Conditions:

1\. The contributor is a Saudi national. \
2. The employment injury resulted in a partial permanent disability to the contributor by (50-99%).

\
**Note:** If the Medical Board decides that the injured contributor is in need of a constant assistance of others in the performance of his everyday life activities, the benefit will be raised by (50%) of the benefit amount, provided that the amount of such allowance does not exceed SR 3,500.

#### Service delivery channels

[](#DetailData)

At

Office

### Payment of total or partial permanent occupational disability lump-sum compensation to non-Saudi contributor.

## Payment of total or partial permanent occupational disability lump-sum compensation to non-Saudi contributor.

#### Procedure Description:

It is a lump sum compensation payable to a non-Saudi contributor.

#### Procedure Conditions:

A non-Saudi contributor sustains an employment injury that led to a partial disability by (50-99%), total permanent disability by (100%) or his death.

#### Service delivery channels

[](#DetailData)

At

Office

### Payment of lump-sum compensation to a Saudi or non-Saudi contributor when sustaining a partial permanent occupational disability that is less than (50%).

#### **Procedure Description:**

It is a lump sum compensation payable to a Saudi or non-Saudi contributor.

#### **Procedure Conditions:**

The employment injury leads to a partial permanent disability that is less than (50%).

#### Service delivery channels

[](#DetailData)

At

Office
